info.title: Gateway admin end-user budgets API
info.description: Budgets per end user of an app (D-028): an app's backend names its user on each inference request (`Gateway-End-User`, or the body's `user`), and the app's service account limits each user by their plan (an allowance per month, week, day or number of days, and optional per-user request and token rate limits) and then prepaid credits, spent soonest-expiring first, reserved with every other budget. These endpoints set the service account's end-user settings and plans, assign users to plans, and grant and reverse credits. Money is in money units, 10⁻⁶ of the currency's smallest unit. Authenticated with a session cookie or an agent token (`Authorization: Bearer gwa_…`), which acts only in its agent's organization: an app's backend uses an agent whose role has `end_user_write` (owner, admin or operator) to assign plans and grant credits without being able to change budgets. Every response is `Cache-Control: no-store`; problems are `application/problem+json`.

get.description: Permission `budget_read`. Removed plans are not listed. Each plan carries its totals: `users`, the end users it is in force for, and `spent_minor`, what their requests settled in the plan's current period were charged.

parameters.name: org
parameters.description: Organization id.

parameters.name: service_account_id

put.description: Permission `budget_write`. Audited as `end_user_plan.set`. Needs end-user settings first. Replaces the whole plan: a field left out takes its default (`monthly`, no rate limits). A changed allowance or limit applies from the next request and keeps the period's spend; a changed period starts the new period's allowance afresh.

post.description: Permission `end_user_write`. Audited as `end_user_credit_grant.created`. Creates the user if never seen. `reference` is unique per service account: the same reference with the same user, amount and expiry returns the existing grant (200); with anything else, 409 `credit_reference_conflict`. No `If-Match`.

post.summary: Take back unspent credit (a refund or chargeback)
post.description: Permission `end_user_write`. Audited as `end_user_credit_grant.reversed`. Takes up to what is unspent and unreserved of the grant, never more; `reversed_minor` says how much. `reference` is unique per grant, with the same rules as grants (409 `reversal_reference_conflict`). No `If-Match`.

agentToken.description: An agent token (`Authorization: Bearer gwa_…`), for automation: it acts as its agent, only in the agent's organization, with the agent's role. Created with `POST /api/admin/v1/organizations/{org}/agents/{agent_id}/tokens` or, on the server, `gateway agent create`.

Forbidden.description: `forbidden`: the actor lacks the required permission for the organization.

requirement.description: `required` refuses inference requests that name no end user (400 `end_user_required`).

currency.description: Every plan, allowance and credit of this service account's users. Fixed once a plan or a grant exists.

default_plan.description: The plan of a user the app never assigned one; `null` refuses such users (403 `end_user_not_registered`). Must name an existing plan.

allowance_minor.description: What each user on the plan may spend per period, in money units; 0 for a credits-only plan.

period.description: How the allowance repeats: the UTC calendar month, the ISO week from Monday 00:00 UTC, the UTC day, or `period_days` days (windows counted from Monday 1970-01-05 00:00 UTC, shared by every user of the plan).

period_days.description: With `period: days` only (and then required): the days in each period.

requests_per_minute.description: Requests each user may make in a sliding 60 seconds; a batch is one. Absent or null: no limit. Over it: 429 `rate_limit_exceeded` with `end_user`, `limit` and `Retry-After`.

tokens_per_minute.description: Tokens each user's requests may hold or use in a sliding 60 seconds: a request in flight counts its input bound, output cap and reasoning allowance, a finished one the tokens its usage reported. A request's output cap is lowered to what fits; one whose input does not fit is refused with 429 `rate_limit_exceeded`. A batch is refused while the minute's tokens are used up; its lines are not counted. Absent or null: no limit.

max_concurrent.description: Requests each user may have in flight at once (batches not counted). Absent or null: no limit. Over it: 429 `concurrency_limit_exceeded` with `end_user`, `limit` and `Retry-After: 1`.

allowance_minor.description: Per period, in money units: 10⁻⁶ of the currency's smallest unit ($1.00 is `100000000`).

period_days.description: The days in each period with `period: days`; null otherwise.

requests_per_minute.description: Per user; null for no limit.

tokens_per_minute.description: Per user; null for no limit.

max_concurrent.description: Per user; null for no limit.

users.description: The end users the plan is in force for: assigned to it, or unassigned while it is the default plan.

spent_minor.description: What those users' requests settled in `period_start`..`period_end` were charged (allowance and credits alike, in `currency`), whichever plan they were on when they made them.

plan.description: The user's plan; `null` puts them on the default plan.
The plan assigned; `null` for the default.

effective_plan.description: The plan in force; `null` when the user is unassigned and there is no default, so requests are refused.

currency.description: `null` when the service account has no end-user settings (users are recorded, not limited).

period_start.description: This period of the plan in force (the UTC calendar month without one), `[period_start, period_end)`.

allowance_minor.description: This period's allowance under the plan in force.

allowance_spent_minor.description: Charged to this period's allowance by settled requests. Can exceed the allowance after usage past a reservation.

allowance_reserved_minor.description: Held for this period's allowance by requests in flight.

allowance_remaining_minor.description: Allowance less spent and reserved; never negative.

credit_balance_minor.description: Unspent, unreserved credit of grants that have not expired.

spent_minor.description: What the user's requests settled this period (`period_start`..`period_end`) were charged, from allowance or credits, in `spent_currency`; a request awaiting reconciliation counts once it is settled. Null when, without end-user settings, they used several currencies.

spent_currency.description: The app's end-user currency; without end-user settings, the one currency the user's requests used this period (null before any).

version.description: Resource version; the `ETag` is `"v{version}"`. 0 for a user only requests have seen (no admin write yet); `If-Match: "v0"` or `*` updates them.

reference.description: The app's purchase or order ID; unique per service account.

amount_minor.description: Money units: 10⁻⁶ of the currency's smallest unit ($1.00 is `100000000`).

expires_at.description: When unspent credit lapses; `null` never. Must be in the future.

amount_minor.description: Money units: 10⁻⁶ of the currency's smallest unit ($1.00 is `100000000`).

reversed_minor.description: Money units: 10⁻⁶ of the currency's smallest unit ($1.00 is `100000000`).

spent_minor.description: Money units: 10⁻⁶ of the currency's smallest unit ($1.00 is `100000000`).

reserved_minor.description: Money units: 10⁻⁶ of the currency's smallest unit ($1.00 is `100000000`).

remaining_minor.description: Amount less reversed, spent and reserved; 0 once expired.

reference.description: The app's refund or chargeback ID; unique per grant.

amount_minor.description: What to take back; at most what is unspent and unreserved is taken.

requested_minor.description: Money units: 10⁻⁶ of the currency's smallest unit ($1.00 is `100000000`).

reversed_minor.description: What was taken: never more than was unspent and unreserved.
